图片内文字：
- Critical assumptions for accelerated best case
- Submission on 29 Oct 2027
- LPO on 01Jul2027, DBL on 26Jul2027, TLR on 05Aug2027
- CMC DS PPQ completion on 25Sep2027 without unexpected analytical results
- PR confirmed in Oct 2027 via pre-NDA (30WD for pediatric case), based on data from ~40 adolescents (75 planned for the trial).
- Whole dossier ready on 15 Oct 2027 in CN and EN
- eCTD publication in one week (vs standard 10WD)
- Resource should be prioritized and sticked
- Approval by end of Jun 2028
- Approval in 8M (vs current benchmark for NDA approval with PR is 12M) including
  - QC testing
  - ad hoc panel meeting
  - potential GMP inspection (if CN progress faster than US)
  - Fast negotiation for approval documents
- DS PPQ=drug substance process performance qualification.
- Boehringer Ingelheim
- ONLY FOR INTERNAL USE
- 3

视觉关系：
- 页面左右两栏对照：左侧为“Submission on 29 Oct 2027”及其前置/支撑事项；右侧为“Approval by end of Jun 2028”及审批周期与包含事项。
- 时间先后关系（由左侧到右侧）：
  - 01Jul2027（LPO）→ 26Jul2027（DBL）→ 05Aug2027（TLR）→ 25Sep2027（CMC DS PPQ completion）→ Oct 2027（PR confirmed）→ 15 Oct 2027（Whole dossier ready）→ 29 Oct 2027（Submission）→ end of Jun 2028（Approval）。
- 审批周期比较关系：Approval in 8M，对比“current benchmark… with PR is 12M”（8个月 vs 12个月）。
- 右侧“Approval in 8M … including”下的4条为该8个月审批周期所包含的组成事项（QC testing、ad hoc panel meeting、potential GMP inspection、Fast negotiation for approval documents）。
